# manual case: FXC/DXBC reaches the two-output instruction from the
# same HLSL that DXC/DXIL lowers to two separate operations.
#
# DXBC has one `udiv destQUOT, destREM, src0, src1` instruction and one
# `imul destHI, destLO, src0, src1` instruction. DXIL keeps them as
# opcodes 43 and 41 (op class binaryWithTwoOuts) but no HLSL spelling
# in DXC lowers to either.

$ "<sdk>/Windows Kits/10/bin/<ver>/x64/fxc.exe" /nologo /T cs_5_0 /E main control-fxc-divrem.hlsl
[note] quotient and remainder of one operand pair -> ONE `udiv` with two destination registers
[exit] 0
[trimmed] resource/signature header omitted; last 12 lines of the disassembly follow
dcl_globalFlags refactoringAllowed
dcl_uav_structured u0, 16
dcl_input vThreadID.x
dcl_temps 2
dcl_thread_group 1, 1, 1
ld_structured_indexable(structured_buffer, stride=16)(mixed,mixed,mixed,mixed) r0.xy, vThreadID.x, l(0), u0.xyxx
udiv r0.x, r1.x, r0.x, r0.y
mov r0.y, r1.x
mov r0.zw, l(0,0,0,0)
store_structured u0.xyzw, vThreadID.x, l(0), r0.xyzw
ret 
// Approximately 6 instruction slots used

$ <repo>/build/Debug/bin/dxc.exe -T cs_6_0 -E main control-fxc-divrem.hlsl
[note] the identical source through DXC -> two independent instructions, no dx.op call
[exit] 0
[filtered] lines containing: udiv, urem, binaryWithTwoOuts
%6 = udiv i32 %4, %5
%7 = urem i32 %4, %5

$ "<sdk>/Windows Kits/10/bin/<ver>/x64/fxc.exe" /nologo /T cs_5_0 /E main control-no-divide.hlsl
[note] an ordinary 32-bit multiply is ALREADY the two-output instruction in DXBC: `imul null, r1.y, ...` discards the high half into null, which is the half HLSL cannot ask for
[exit] 0
[trimmed] resource/signature header omitted; last 12 lines of the disassembly follow
dcl_uav_structured u0, 16
dcl_input vThreadID.x
dcl_temps 2
dcl_thread_group 1, 1, 1
ld_structured_indexable(structured_buffer, stride=16)(mixed,mixed,mixed,mixed) r0.xy, vThreadID.x, l(0), u0.xyxx
iadd r1.x, r0.y, r0.x
imul null, r1.y, r0.y, r0.x
iadd r1.z, -r0.y, r0.x
xor r1.w, r0.y, r0.x
store_structured u0.xyzw, vThreadID.x, l(0), r1.xyzw
ret 
// Approximately 7 instruction slots used

$ <repo>/build/Debug/bin/dxc.exe -T cs_6_0 -E main repro.hlsl
[note] the repro through DXC: the high half costs a 64-bit multiply and the optional 64-bit feature flag
[exit] 0
[filtered] lines containing: 64-Bit, mul nuw, lshr, trunc i64, udiv, urem
;       64-Bit integer
%8 = mul nuw i64 %7, %6
%9 = lshr i64 %8, 32
%10 = trunc i64 %9 to i32
%11 = trunc i64 %8 to i32
%12 = udiv i32 %4, %5
%13 = urem i32 %4, %5
